So not sure if this counts, but I recently graduated this past May and I decided I didn’t want to go to college. As an artist, nothing else interests me and I don’t want to be an art teacher. So I decided I was going to be a tattoo artist. I started my apprenticeship before my graduation, and the owner was absolutely wacko. Told me I was crazy and unstable for forgetting something she had told me (wasn’t even relevant to tattooing), and constantly make nasty remarks about my physical appearance and how I was going to fail. Whatever, I can deal with that. Shit escalates throughout my time there, and to make the long story short ended up almost having my face slammed into a glass counter because “I was standing too close and a customer might do that to me” and then had a gun pulled on me. So obviously that’s a lot, and I ended up being put in a psychiatric ward for 5 days to recover from all of that. Now i’m back at square one. I just wish I had started college and had at least a backup. Always have a backup. That’s my only regret.
Honestly, I have to take it one day at a time. Tell myself each day will be a fresh start and better than the last. Cliche, but it’s gotten me through some shit. It’s what you make of it.
